nc8333307eb.headline: Stock market update: Nifty Realty index  1.06%
nc8333307eb.summary: The Nifty Realty index closed 1.06 per cent at 1,051.65, according to the market update.
nc8333307eb.why: The Nifty Realty index tracks listed Indian real estate developers, a sector sensitive to interest rates and housing demand.

n051b6bf23d.headline: Power is restored to nearly all of Puerto Rico after a major blackout
n051b6bf23d.summary: Lights have returned to nearly all Puerto Rico households, hospitals, water plants and sewage facilities after a massive outage that exposed persistent electricity problems.
n051b6bf23d.why: Reliable power supply is essential for economic activity, and recurring grid failures raise costs and risks for businesses on the island.

ndea72bddb3.headline: SA economy expected to improve in 2025, but geopolitical risks remain
ndea72bddb3.summary: Economists now expect South Africa's economy to grow in 2025 and inflation to stay low, though geopolitical risks remain.
ndea72bddb3.why: South Africa is Africa's most industrialized economy, and its growth and inflation outlook shape investment and rand-denominated asset returns.

n0f3d09dfd4.headline: How oversupply is affecting Mexico's Tequila industry
n0f3d09dfd4.summary: Tequila demand has weakened as Mexico is left with a 500 million litre surplus of its national drink.
n0f3d09dfd4.why: Tequila is an agave-based spirit produced almost entirely in Mexico, so demand and inventory levels directly affect the country's spirits exports.

ne4ff21a43c.headline: Manufacturing industry shrinks at fastest rate in 11 months in ‘winter chill’
ne4ff21a43c.summary: British factories reported contraction in December, the fastest in 11 months. Manufacturers cited concerns about rising business taxes and a weaker global economy.
ne4ff21a43c.why: Manufacturing surveys such as the PMI are closely watched leading indicators of UK economic activity, influencing expectations for Bank of England policy and sterling.

n86061a19a6.headline: Avian influenza cases mount up in England
n86061a19a6.summary: Further cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza were confirmed in England over the festive period. The article reports 15 cases of the H5N1 strain.
n86061a19a6.why: Avian influenza outbreaks force culling of poultry flocks, affecting egg and poultry supply, producer costs and trade restrictions for UK poultry exporters.

nff23378460.headline: Puerto Rico swears in new governor days after major blackout left much of the island in the dark - The Boston Globe
nff23378460.summary: Puerto Rico swore in a new governor, González, days after a major blackout left much of the island without power.
nff23378460.why: Puerto Rico is a US territory whose government and power grid shape its economy, and grid reliability affects businesses and investment.

n3a4e1efeda.headline: Could Gauteng really go bankrupt in 2025?
n3a4e1efeda.summary: Gauteng province is at risk of bankruptcy, with strain from the health department putting immense pressure on its finances.
n3a4e1efeda.why: Gauteng is South Africa's economic hub, so its fiscal health affects public service delivery, infrastructure spending and investor confidence in the province.

nd902516e19.headline: HIVE Aims for 150% Growth by 2025 Following 47% Operational Surge in 2024
nd902516e19.summary: HIVE Digital Technologies targets 150% growth by 2025, aiming for 15 EH/s of bitcoin mining capacity. The goal follows a 47% operational surge in 2024.
nd902516e19.why: HIVE is a bitcoin mining company, so its hashrate growth targets relate directly to its mining output and the economics of bitcoin production.

nba1e621a48.headline: Singapore economy grows 4 percent, tops forecasts - Taipei Times
nba1e621a48.summary: Singapore's economy grew 4% last year, beating forecasts despite a slowdown in the fourth quarter, preliminary government data showed. Growth accelerated from 1.1% in 2023.
nba1e621a48.why: Singapore is a trade-reliant hub, so its GDP growth is a key indicator of Asian trade and regional demand.

nf302a4919a.headline: Tesla narrowly beats BYD to global EV sales title despite first-ever annual decline
nf302a4919a.summary: Tesla's sales fell year on year for the first time in its history, yet it narrowly edged out BYD for the global electric vehicle sales title.
nf302a4919a.why: Tesla is a US electric vehicle and energy maker, and BYD is a Chinese EV and battery producer. Their sales rankings are closely watched as indicators of EV demand and competition.

impacts.why: Tesla's annual sales declined for the first time, pointing to weaker EV volumes.

n49eef47f92.headline: Cyprus Consumer Price Inflation At 6-month High
n49eef47f92.summary: Consumer price inflation in Cyprus accelerated sharply in December to its highest level in six months, driven mainly by food prices, preliminary data showed.
n49eef47f92.why: Consumer price inflation drives central bank policy expectations and real household spending power, which matters for local bonds and the euro-area economy.

n4e9abcee8c.headline: Volatility seen at PSX, KSE-100 closes nearly flat
n4e9abcee8c.summary: The benchmark KSE-100 index swung in both directions during a volatile session on the Pakistan Stock Exchange before closing nearly flat.
n4e9abcee8c.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in Pakistan.

n0175b60faf.headline: Greece to Roll Out Major Tax Cuts and Income Support Measures in 2025
n0175b60faf.summary: Greece will implement 18 tax reductions and 7 income support measures in 2025, totaling €1.5 billion, aimed at raising disposable income. The measures build on years of economic growth and efforts to combat tax evasion.
n0175b60faf.why: Greece's fiscal policy shapes government budgets, sovereign debt sustainability and consumer spending in the euro area's southern economies.

n22f1aaf89e.headline: Oil rises on shrinking US oil inventories
n22f1aaf89e.summary: Oil prices rose on shrinking US oil inventories. Traders awaited the US Energy Information Administration's weekly stocks report, where a decline was expected.
n22f1aaf89e.why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity, and US inventory data is a key weekly signal for global supply and demand.
n22f1aaf89e.why_moved: Shrinking US oil inventories point to tighter supply, and traders were positioning ahead of the EIA stocks report.

n244ff7e7e0.headline: Things That May Affect Agriculture in 2025
n244ff7e7e0.summary: A majority of agricultural economists in the latest Monthly Monitor say US agriculture ended 2024 in a recession. The survey covers the sector's economic outlook for 2025.
n244ff7e7e0.why: Farm incomes and commodity prices affect food costs, rural lending and the earnings of agribusiness companies. Economists' surveys are a gauge of sector health.

nb411156aab.headline: Nigerian senator canvasses more enlightenment on tax bills
nb411156aab.summary: Abia senator Orji Kalus said the tax reform bills are necessary but many Nigerians are unaware of their economic benefits. He called for more public enlightenment on the bills.
nb411156aab.why: Tax reform changes government revenue and the business environment, which matters for companies operating in Nigeria.

n48320fff58.headline: Tether, Tron and TRM Labs jointly froze $126M USDT in 2024
n48320fff58.summary: The T3 Financial Crime Unit, formed by Tether, the Tron Network and TRM Labs, has frozen roughly $126 million in USDT stablecoins since August 2024. The unit targets illicit activity on the networks.
n48320fff58.why: Tether issues USDT, the largest stablecoin by market value, and its freezing actions affect liquidity and compliance across crypto markets. Law enforcement cooperation shapes regulatory scrutiny of stablecoins.

n9f23e98cc0.headline: Binance secures 21st global crypto license in Brazil
n9f23e98cc0.summary: Binance secured its 21st global regulatory approval by acquiring Sim;paul in Brazil, becoming the first crypto exchange with a broker-dealer licence in the country.
n9f23e98cc0.why: Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by volume. Regulatory licences determine where it can offer services and shape competition in local crypto markets.

n78ad9999db.headline: West Red Lake Gold Closes US$35-Million Credit Facility with Nebari and Announces Drawdown of US$15 Million
n78ad9999db.summary: West Red Lake Gold Mines entered a completed credit agreement with Nebari Natural Resources on December 31, 2024. It also announced a US$15 million drawdown under the US$35 million facility.
n78ad9999db.why: Gold miners use credit facilities to fund exploration and development, and financing terms affect their capacity to advance projects.

nd0c2f730c5.headline: Cities cut red tape to turn unused office buildings into housing
nd0c2f730c5.summary: Nearly a fifth of US office space sits empty, a record high vacancy rate, according to the report. Cities are cutting red tape to turn these buildings into housing.
nd0c2f730c5.why: Office vacancies affect commercial property values and lenders, while conversions add to the housing supply that influences rents.

n7c5894046a.headline: Why did the BHP share price crash 21% in 2024?
n7c5894046a.summary: BHP Group's shares fell about 21% in 2024, according to a Motley Fool Australia review of why investors sold the stock. The article examines the reasons behind the selloff.
n7c5894046a.why: BHP is one of the world's largest diversified miners, producing iron ore, copper and metallurgical coal, so its share price reflects global commodity demand and China's economy.

nbbeb81fc1f.headline: Canada's 100 highest-paid CEOs earned $13.2 million on average in 2023: report
nbbeb81fc1f.summary: Canada's 100 highest-paid CEOs earned an average of $13.2 million in 2023 from salaries, bonuses and other compensation, according to the Canadian Centre for Policy Alternatives.
nbbeb81fc1f.why: Executive pay levels are a governance and shareholder-relations issue for investors evaluating corporate compensation practices in Canada.

n40ff7cdb5d.headline: Inflation: Labour pushes for minimum wage increase in 2025
n40ff7cdb5d.summary: The Organised Labour is pushing for an annual increase to the N70,000 minimum wage paid to workers in Nigeria, citing inflation. Negotiations on the wage level are ongoing.
n40ff7cdb5d.why: Minimum wage decisions affect labour costs for employers and household spending power, and they are closely watched amid high inflation in Nigeria.

n48169c3f06.headline: Exclusive: GTBank gets court order to recover ₦1.9 billion erroneously credited to customer accounts in October 2024
n48169c3f06.summary: Guaranty Trust Bank has been granted a court order to recover ₦1.9 billion mistakenly credited to customer accounts on October 28 and 29, 2024. The bank has a market capitalisation of ₦1.68 trillion.
n48169c3f06.why: GTBank is a major Nigerian commercial bank, and its handling of operational errors and recoveries bears on its financial controls and reputation.

n69f7755668.headline: What's going on with Lendlease shares today?
n69f7755668.summary: The UK has attempted to restart economic talks with China after a six-year gap. The Labour government hopes to repair strained ties, but the trip has drawn criticism amid financial turmoil.
n69f7755668.why: Trade and investment relations between the UK and China affect British exporters, financial firms and supply chains that depend on Chinese demand and inputs.

n6cba1a2686.headline: Shares at PSX gain 100 points amid mixed economic indicators
n6cba1a2686.summary: Shares on the Pakistan Stock Exchange gained 100 points amid mixed economic indicators. An analyst attributed investor jitters to higher-than-expected trade deficit figures.
n6cba1a2686.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's KSE-100 index tracks the country's largest listed companies and reflects investor sentiment on the economy.

nd68869c913.headline: The Volatility of the Coffee Market Is Starting to Resemble Cryptocurrency Fluctuations
nd68869c913.summary: Coffee prices rose sharply in late November after a steady climb, with volatility now drawing comparisons to cryptocurrency price fluctuations.
nd68869c913.why: Coffee is a globally traded soft commodity, and its futures prices affect roasters, retailers and commodity-focused portfolios.

n2f55774200.headline: Perth loses its housing market crown as peak growth passes
n2f55774200.summary: Perth lost its position as the strongest housing market among Australia's capitals as three other capitals recorded falling home values. Perth had enjoyed double-digit annual growth in 2024, but experts warn growth has passed its peak.
n2f55774200.why: Residential property values influence household wealth, bank lending and the broader Australian economy.

n098861d3a8.headline: India's Alternate Investment Landscape in 2024: Shifting Patterns Revealed | Headlines
n098861d3a8.summary: VCCEdge's 16th annual report shows a decline in private equity investment in India in 2024, with B2B, ecommerce and health tech emerging as focus areas.
n098861d3a8.why: Alternative investments such as private equity and venture capital fund much of India's growth-company financing, so shifts in deal activity matter to investors.

n083e628e9c.headline: Lidl GB scores over £1bn in festive sales
n083e628e9c.summary: Lidl GB generated over £1bn in festive sales and gained 2 million extra customers this Christmas as shoppers sought out bargains.
n083e628e9c.why: Lidl is a discount grocery chain competing with Tesco, Sainsbury's and Asda in the UK, so its sales trends signal consumer demand in grocery retail.

nfde6eabb09.headline: House prices went up £12,000 in 2024
nfde6eabb09.summary: Prices have risen consecutively for the past four months according to Nationwide. Buyers are reportedly looking to avoid paying more tax on their purchases.
nfde6eabb09.why: Nationwide is a major UK mortgage lender whose house price index is closely watched as a gauge of the UK housing market.

n1c7edde5c5.headline: Currency Market Today: Rupee falls 9 paise to close at 85.73 against US dollar
n1c7edde5c5.summary: The rupee closed 9 paise weaker at 85.73 against the US dollar on Thursday, provisionally. Strong dollar demand from importers and foreign fund outflows weighed on sentiment.
n1c7edde5c5.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects the cost of India's oil and other imports and the returns of foreign investors in Indian assets.

n2db84b8718.headline: Dow Drops 152, Nasdaq Loses 30, S&P 500 Slips 13
n2db84b8718.summary: Wall Street opened 2025 with modest losses, with the Dow down 152 points, the Nasdaq down 30 points and the S&P 500 down 13 points.
n2db84b8718.why: The Dow, Nasdaq and S&P 500 are the main benchmarks tracking U.S. large-cap and technology stock performance.

na4d4b16b1d.headline: Carnival Cruise Line Decides to Stop Offering Gift Cards Through AARP
na4d4b16b1d.summary: AARP will no longer sell discounted gift cards for Carnival Cruise Line, which many customers had used to save money on sailings.
na4d4b16b1d.why: Carnival Corporation is one of the world's largest cruise operators, and its distribution and discount channels affect bookings.

ncdcba0bbab.headline: Tesla Faces Challenges Amidst Declining EV Deliveries and Shifting Market Dynamics | Business
ncdcba0bbab.summary: Tesla reported its first annual fall in deliveries, which it attributed to high costs and aging models. Competition from BYD and other factors poses challenges.
ncdcba0bbab.why: Tesla is a leading global electric vehicle maker, so its delivery trends signal demand across the EV sector.

n21d657a157.headline: Failed jeonse deposit returns near 2 trillion won
n21d657a157.summary: Over 1,000 landlords nationwide have repeatedly failed to return tenants' jeonse deposits, with arrears reaching 1.9 trillion won, according to The Korea Herald.
n21d657a157.why: Jeonse is a Korean lease system in which tenants pay a large lump-sum deposit, so landlord defaults expose tenants to losses and strain the rental housing market.

nf1d1ff0b0a.headline: Honda CEO struggles to name benefits of Nissan merger
nf1d1ff0b0a.summary: A Honda-Nissan merger appears almost certain, but Honda's CEO has struggled to name its benefits. The report comes from an Australian regional news site.
nf1d1ff0b0a.why: Honda and Nissan are major Japanese automakers, and a combination would reshape competition in global vehicle and electric-vehicle markets.

nfb584bd3fb.headline: South Korea cuts growth forecast after martial law - Taipei Times
nfb584bd3fb.summary: South Korea cut its economic growth forecast for this year, citing fallout from impeached President Yoon Suk-yeol's martial law and risks from US tariff plans under president-elect Donald Trump.
nfb584bd3fb.why: South Korea is a trade-dependent economy whose exports and growth are closely watched by global investors. Growth forecasts influence expectations for the won, local equities and central bank policy.

n5bc13bed5e.headline: Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves $16.41 billion
n5bc13bed5e.summary: Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves stood at $16,408.7 million as of December 27, 2024. The input also refers to reserves held by the State Bank.
n5bc13bed5e.why: Liquid foreign reserves indicate a central bank's capacity to meet external obligations and defend its currency.

n7c5ac571ed.headline: Rupee sheds 09 paisa against dollar
n7c5ac571ed.summary: The Pakistani rupee depreciated by 9 paisa against the US dollar in interbank trading on Thursday. It closed at Rs278.64 against the dollar.
n7c5ac571ed.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs and inflation in Pakistan, and it is closely watched by foreign investors.

n591f327d8b.headline: Fiserv to acquire Payfare in $201.5-million CAD deal after swiping its DoorDash business
n591f327d8b.summary: Fiserv agreed to acquire Payfare in a C$201.5-million deal. The pending transaction follows Payfare's share price plunge and a strategic review in September.
n591f327d8b.why: Fiserv is a large US payments processor, and Payfare is a Toronto-based fintech payments company. Acquisitions like this reshape competition in payment processing.

n5897b75db2.headline: Canada’s manufacturing sector remains resilient in December, PMI at 52.2
n5897b75db2.summary: Canada's manufacturing sector remained resilient in December with a PMI of 52.2. Manufacturers are preparing for the impact of U.S. tariffs while managing supply chain pressures.
n5897b75db2.why: The PMI is a monthly survey of factory activity, and readings above 50 signal expansion. Canada's manufacturing sector is highly exposed to U.S. trade policy.

n8d2afcf27b.headline: Anil Ambani starts 2025 with a bang, Reliance Power repays Rs 12840000000 loan by…
n8d2afcf27b.summary: Reliance Power successfully repays a large debt, indicating improved financial health and liquidity position.
n8d2afcf27b.why: Debt repayment impacts company creditworthiness and investor confidence in India's power sector.
